result.instructions: Tools for IDX Broker, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which new leads signed up in the last 24 hours?"; "Show me everything lead 4512 viewed and searched for."; "Add a note to lead 4512: asked for a showing on Saturday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes IDX Broker data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run idx_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run idx_request_feature to record the request. Paid options: a 7-day pass ($5 once, no subscription, unlimited calls for 7 days) or Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year). When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run idx_upgrade (plan "pass", "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. idx_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: idx_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new lead in the IDX Broker account (and may trigger the account's own lead notifications). Needs a correctly formatted email with a valid MX record; IDX rejects bad addresses with a server error. Extra fields go in `fields` by their IDX name, as seen on a lead returned by idx_get_lead. Returns the new lead id. PUT /leads/lead.

fields.description: Other updatable lead fields by IDX name, e.g. {"phone": "555-0100"}. firstName, lastName and email cannot be repeated here.

tools.name: idx_add_lead_note
tools.title: Add lead note
tools.description: WRITE: adds a note to a lead (visible to the account's agents). Returns the new note id. PUT /leads/note/{leadID}.

tools.name: idx_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: WRITE: changes fields of an existing lead; the given values replace the stored ones. Only pass what must change. Field names are the IDX lead field names as seen on a lead returned by idx_get_lead (for example firstName, lastName, email, phone, status). POST /leads/lead/{leadID}.

fields.description: Fields to set, by IDX name, e.g. {"phone": "555-0100"}.
